title: Agent Ready GEO: an agent skill that makes a website agent-ready
description:
Agent Ready GEO is an agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and other clients that load Agent Skills. It reads a website's score on isitagentready.com and builds the missing pieces on the site's own hosting: robots.txt rules for AI crawlers and Content Signals, a sitemap, Link headers, Markdown for agents, llms.txt and llms-full.txt, an API catalog and an OpenAPI document, a running MCP server and its server card, an Agent Skills index whose digests match the bytes actually served, WebMCP browser tools, ARD, OAuth discovery and auth.md, DNS-AID records, and Web Bot Auth where the site signs its own requests.

Capabilities presented as available have to work: a file named mcp is not an MCP server, and changing a Content-Type header is not Markdown negotiation. Anything not built yet is published only as a labeled coming-soon declaration that the site owner approves, with its endpoints answering 503 and its planned state readable by people and machines. DNS, authentication, firewall and account changes wait for the owner's explicit approval of the listed change, no exception is ever keyed site-wide on a User-Agent, and no file the skill writes on a site carries the skill's name or a link back to it.

The instructions are written in iLang, a plain-text instruction format, and pass the iLang grammar validator with no errors or warnings. Two scripts ship with the skill: a bounded read-only probe that collects HTTP and DNS evidence, and a verifier that checks a site folder before deployment or a probe run afterwards. Both are Python 3.9 standard library only and are covered by 138 offline tests. Two sites built with this method scored 100 on isitagentready.com on 2026-09-19.
